title: templates/ e .claude/ sao dois documentos mantidos a mao sem gate de drift: colapsar em fonte unica
description:
PROBLEMA

templates/ e as copias instaladas (.claude/, scripts/cam/) sao dois conjuntos de documentos mantidos a mao, sem nenhum gate que reprove quando divergem. A consequencia nao e hipotetica: ja ha drift bidirecional em producao, e ele ja cegou o proprio orquestrador para um marcador de falha vivo.

MEDICAO (2026-08-10, varredura read-only)

27 arquivos em templates/, 27 pares mapeados. 15 byte-identicos, 12 divergentes, 0 template-only.
Dos 12 divergentes, 3 sao semente-contra-vivo e estao corretos (journal.md, patterns.md, suggestions.jsonl). Os outros 9 sao pares de documento que deveriam concordar.

NAO EXISTE GATE DE DRIFT. embed-vendor:check compara apenas templates/ contra src/vendor/_generated.ts (scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts:137-154 le somente VENDOR_DIR e TEMPLATES_DIR). Ele e estruturalmente incapaz de comparar repo contra template. Prova: sai 0 hoje, com 12 pares divergentes. A unica enforcement existente e uma linha de checklist em .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, ou seja, um checkbox de LLM. O drift observado prova que o checkbox nao segura.

DRIFT REAL JA EM PRODUCAO

1. Template a frente do repo. templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md:152 tem o item 12 do boot, ler .claude/.cam-sidecar-stalled.json, com o paragrafo de blocker em :250. A copia do repo tem zero ocorrencias e renumera para "(7-12)". O commit eb955511 (CAM-207) tocou apenas o caminho do template. O marcador e codigo vivo: src/supervisor/sidecar-stalled.ts, src/commands/sidecar-liveness-watch.ts:9, src/commands/status.ts:324. Efeito medido: a persona do orquestrador deste repo boota cega para um marcador de falha real.

2. Repo a frente do template. .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md:119 documenta a forma variadica de gship suggestions promote, e a triagem em memory/project_suggestion_triage.md. O template ainda documenta a forma de fingerprint unico. O commit 46a4180c (CAM-378) tocou o repo, index.ts e src/commands/suggestions.ts, e nao tocou templates/. O CLI shipado e variadico, entao o template mis-documenta comportamento vivo.

3. Schemas, drift nos dois sentidos. scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json tem 3 propriedades que o template nao tem (appliedPatternIds, channel, localConventionConflict); projetos downstream recebem um schema que ignora campos que o implementer shipado escreve. Em sentido inverso, scripts/cam/issues.schema.json:4 e scripts/cam/orch-handoff.schema.json:4 e :46 ainda dizem cam onde o template ja diz gship: as copias do repo perderam o rename do produto.

4. Auto-refutacao. scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md do repo ganhou a secao Domain Model Convention, que afirma textualmente valer "para qualquer projeto downstream inicializado pelo gship init". Essa secao esta ausente do arquivo que o gship init entrega. O mesmo vale para a secao Knowledge-Layer Routing, tambem generica e tambem ausente do template.

5. Inventario re-enumerado a mao em 3 lugares, um ja stale. src/commands/setup.ts:386-388 informa ao agente de setup que os comandos instalados sao 6, omitindo cam-spec.md, que e o setimo shipado. Alem disso o array targets em setup.ts:359-364 lista 4 subtrees enquanto SUBTREES em src/templates/embedded.ts:30 tem 5.

POR QUE A RESPOSTA NAO E ADICIONAR UM GATE DE DRIFT

Adicionar um gate que vigia duas copias mantidas a mao aumenta a complexidade que causou o problema. Com fonte unica, o gate deixa de precisar existir: nao ha o que divergir. Isso e a premissa do produto (root CLAUDE.md, secao Premise, commit 7f6e85aa) aplicada a propria oficina: encolher a superficie primeiro, policiar apenas o que sobra.

ESCOPO PROPOSTO

a) Colapsar em fonte unica os 15 pares hoje byte-identicos: 7 comandos (cam-issue, cam-next, cam-plan, cam-prune, cam-review, cam-ship, cam-spec), 5 skills, subagent-planner.md, o hook orch-agent-allowlist.sh e settings.json. Duas copias a mao dos mesmos bytes e risco puro sem beneficio.

b) Colapsar os 3 schemas (handoff, issues, orch-handoff) apos reconciliar as 19 linhas de divergencia, que sao drift puro. Descrevem um unico formato de wire compartilhado entre harness e projetos downstream; nao ha razao legitima para duas versoes. Com (a), 18 dos 27 arquivos passam a ter fonte unica.

c) Os 9 pares que precisam mesmo de duas versoes (4 personas de agente mais scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, mais .gitignore) devem virar base compartilhada mais overlay do projeto, nao dois documentos mantidos a mao. A copia do repo nomeia bun run typecheck, Ink, tmux; o template precisa ser agnostico de stack. Com base mais overlay, melhoria generica (a regra de Read antes de Write, a tabela de roteamento, o item 12 do boot) cai nos dois por construcao.

d) Reconciliar os defeitos vivos listados acima como parte do colapso, porque colapsar exige decidir qual lado vence em cada divergencia.

DECISAO DE DESIGN QUE A SPEC PRECISA TOMAR

Qual mecanismo de fonte unica: geracao a partir de um diretorio canonico, includes por marcador, ou overlay declarativo. O prior art da industria e fonte unica mais geracao mais gate de drift no padrao do cruft check --exit-code; cookiecutter nunca resolveu isso (issue 784 aberta ha anos); copier e o unico scaffolder com update bidirecional de primeira classe. Nosso espelho mantido a mao e o padrao minoritario.

Restricao dura: templates/ alimenta o codegen scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts, cuja saida src/vendor/_generated.ts (199100 bytes) e commitada e embarcada no binario por bun build --compile. Qualquer mecanismo novo precisa manter esse caminho intacto e o embed-vendor:check verde.

FORA DE ESCOPO

O gate agents-md e a corretude semantica da superficie de instrucao ficam no CAM-529. Este issue trata da duplicacao estrutural; aquele trata do que resta depois dela.

spec.scope: Collapse the hand-maintained duplication between templates/ and the repo's own installed copies (.claude/, scripts/cam/) into a single source, in four verification-isolated stories: (US-001) reconcile all pure drift with the winning side decided per hunk BY THIS SPEC, which also graduates subagent-orchestrator.md to byte-identical; (US-002) collapse the 19 identical pairs to git-tracked symlinks plus a bidirectional integrity gate that also fences the three seed-vs-live files against ever being linked; (US-003) derive the four genuinely-divergent documents from templates/ base plus an exact-anchor {find, replace} overlay, with a --check gate that fails closed on anchor miss or ambiguity; (US-004) derive the installed-file inventory in setup.ts and INIT_HELP from the embedded template map instead of the four parallel hand-enumerations, two of which are already stale. OUT OF SCOPE, filed separately: installer write-policy data loss (CAM-531), the false nested-CLAUDE.md auto-load claim in five personas (CAM-532), and generifying the 22 stack-leaking lines in shared template text (CAM-533). The .gitignore pair keeps its existing behavioral parity gate; only the missing .env.*.local pattern is reconciled.
acceptanceCriteria:
US-001 | The repo-wins hunk (variadic `gship suggestions promote <fp> [<fp> ...]` + the 2026-07-20 triage-policy paragraph) lands verbatim in the template copy. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle (the empty-anchor guard is mandatory: with a typo'd anchor both sides are empty and a bare diff returns 0, a false green):
H1='/pending entries), `gship suggestions promote/,/^6\. `git status`/'
W=$(git show main:.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md | sed -n "${H1}p")
[ -n "$W" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN: anchor matched nothing on the winning side"; exit 2; }
printf '%s\n' "$W" | diff - <(sed -n "${H1}p" templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md)
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1 (winning side 15 lines, template side 5).

US-001 | The template-wins hunks (boot item 12 for `.claude/.cam-sidecar-stalled.json`, plus its blocker-line paragraph) land verbatim in the repo copy, including the renumber back to 13 and the "(7-13)" shared-rule range. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
H2='/^12\. `\.claude\/\.cam-sidecar-stalled\.json`/,/^\*\*Shared rule for every boot-surfaced marker/'
H3='/^If `\.claude\/\.cam-sidecar-stalled\.json` is present/,/^If `\.claude\/\.cam-gate\.json` is present/'
rc=0
for H in "$H2" "$H3"; do
  W=$(git show main:templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md | sed -n "${H}p")
  [ -n "$W" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN: anchor matched nothing on the winning side"; exit 2; }
  printf '%s\n' "$W" | diff - <(sed -n "${H}p" .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md) || rc=1
done
exit $rc
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1 (winning side 13 + 11 lines, repo side 0 + 0).

US-001 | After both directions land, the `subagent-orchestrator.md` pair is byte-identical, which is what graduates it into the symlink population. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
cmp -s .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1.

US-001 | The template is not rewritten anywhere outside the promote/triage hunk (no collateral edit rides along). Species: INVARIANCE PIN, comparand derived at check time from `git show main:templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md`. Oracle:
H1='/pending entries), `gship suggestions promote/,/^6\. `git status`/'
diff <(git show main:templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md | sed -e "${H1}d") <(sed -e "${H1}d" templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md)
Verified GREEN on main 2026-08-11: exit 0.

US-001 | `handoff.schema.json`: the template gains the repo's three extra properties and the pair becomes byte-identical. The property names are never written into the oracle, they are derived. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
diff <(git show main:scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json | jq -S .) <(jq -S . templates/scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json) && cmp -s scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json templates/scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1. Auditable listing (`comm -23` over `jq -r '[paths|join(".")]'` of the two main blobs) yields exactly properties.appliedPatternIds, properties.officialDocsValidated.items.properties.channel, properties.officialDocsValidated.items.properties.localConventionConflict.

US-001 | `issues.schema.json` and `orch-handoff.schema.json`: the repo copies gain the cam->gship rename (template wins) and both pairs become byte-identical. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
rc=0
for f in issues.schema.json orch-handoff.schema.json; do
  diff <(git show main:templates/scripts/cam/"$f") scripts/cam/"$f" || rc=1
  cmp -s scripts/cam/"$f" templates/scripts/cam/"$f" || rc=1
done
exit $rc
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1.

US-001 | Every non-blank line of the generic `scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md` sections (Knowledge-Layer Routing, Domain Model Convention, Release Conventions, and the Test-quality invariant bullet) is present VERBATIM in the template. This is the evidence-fidelity oracle, not a token-presence grep: the comparand is the live line set read out of main, so replacing any quoted claim with plausible invented prose makes that line missing and turns it red. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION (fidelity-grade). Oracle:
M=$({ git show main:scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | sed -n '/^## Knowledge-Layer Routing$/,/^## Cross-Repo PRDs/p'
      git show main:scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | sed -n '/^## Release Conventions$/,$p'
      git show main:scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | grep -F -e '- **Test quality**:'; } | grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*$' | grep -vF -e 'ADR-0059' -e 'lessons.archive.md')
[ -n "$M" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN: derivation produced zero lines"; exit 2; }
printf '%s\n' "$M" | grep -Fxvf templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md && exit 1
exit 0
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1, 41 lines missing. NOTE the `grep -F -e` form is mandatory; without `-e` the leading `-` of the bullet is parsed as an option and the oracle errors.

US-001 | The stack-specific content stays repo-only (no Bun/Ink/tmux leak into the base via the Project Stack section) and the template keeps at least as many `<project ...>` placeholders as it has on main. Species: INVARIANCE PIN, both comparands derived at check time. Oracle:
L=$(git show main:scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | sed -n '/^## Project Stack$/,/^## Quality Gates$/p' | grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*$' | grep -vE '^## ' | grep -Fxf templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md)
[ -z "$L" ] || { echo "STACK LEAK INTO TEMPLATE:"; printf '%s\n' "$L"; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -coF '<project ' templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md)" -ge "$(git show main:templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | grep -coF '<project ')" ]
Verified GREEN on main 2026-08-11: exit 0 (7 placeholders both sides). Do NOT replace this with the naive negative `! grep -q noUncheckedIndexedAccess templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md`: that is jointly unsatisfiable, because the template legitimately carries `<project's strict-mode flag, e.g. noUncheckedIndexedAccess>`. Do NOT widen the sed range to `## Quality Gates` either: the line "Run these before committing. Fix failures before proceeding:" is shared boilerplate and the wider form over-fires (measured leak-count 1 on main).

US-001 | The stack-agnostic `Read`-before-`Write` mandate propagates to the template implementer persona. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
A='/^3\. Use the \*\*`Read` tool\*\*/'
W=$(git show main:.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md | sed -n "${A}p")
[ -n "$W" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN"; exit 2; }
printf '%s\n' "$W" | diff - <(sed -n "${A}p" templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md)
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1.

US-001 | The repo root `.gitignore` covers every pattern line present in `templates/.gitignore` (set containment, literal-free). Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
test -z "$(comm -23 <(grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' templates/.gitignore | sort -u) <(grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' .gitignore | sort -u))"
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1, difference set is exactly one line, `.env.*.local`, so this form is precisely satisfiable by the stated change and nothing more. Confirmed non-perturbing: `bash scripts/check-gitignore-parity.sh .` reports PROBES=43 EXIT=0 and its probe set derives only from cam-*/scripts/cam/* names.

US-001 | The single TEMPLATE-WINS hunk in the reviewer persona lands: the repo copy restores `it` to the test-naming rule (`describe`/`test`/`it`), which the repo copy had narrowed for no reason while cam-cli's own suite uses `it`. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
A='/^- Test names read as behavior/,/strings/'
W=$(git show main:templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md | sed -n '139p')
[ -n "$W" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN"; exit 2; }
printf '%s\n' "$W" | diff - <(sed -n '/`describe`\/`test`/p' .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md | head -1)
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11 (repo line reads `describe`/`test`, template reads `describe`/`test`/`it`). The implementer must re-derive the line numbers after the other US-001 edits rather than trusting 139; anchor on the backticked token list, not the line number.

US-002 | Every population-A path is a symlink IN THE GIT INDEX (mode 120000) resolving to its `templates/` counterpart, and the population size is derived from the template tree rather than asserted. Checking the index rather than `test -L` is deliberate: it catches a worktree symlink committed as a regular file under core.symlinks=false. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
dest() { case "$1" in
  commands/*)    echo ".claude/commands/${1#commands/}";;
  agents/*)      echo ".claude/agents/${1#agents/}";;
  scripts/cam/*) echo "scripts/cam/${1#scripts/cam/}";;
  skills/*)      echo ".claude/skills/${1#skills/}";;
  *)             echo "$1";;
esac; }
NOTLINK='.gitignore
scripts/cam/journal.md
scripts/cam/patterns.md
scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl
.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md
.claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md
.claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md
scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md'
rc=0; a=0
for t in $(cd templates && find . -type f | sed 's|^\./||' | sort); do
  d=$(dest "$t")
  printf '%s\n' "$NOTLINK" | grep -Fxq "$d" && continue
  a=$((a+1))
  m=$(git ls-files -s -- "$d" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  [ "$m" = 120000 ] || { echo "NOT-SYMLINK-IN-INDEX $d (mode=${m:-absent})"; rc=1; continue; }
  got=$(cd "$(dirname "$d")" && readlink -f "$(basename "$d")")
  want=$(readlink -f "templates/$t")
  [ "$got" = "$want" ] || { echo "WRONG-TARGET $d -> $got (want $want)"; rc=1; }
done
exp=$(( $(cd templates && find . -type f | wc -l) - $(printf '%s\n' "$NOTLINK" | wc -l) ))
[ "$a" -eq "$exp" ] || { echo "POPULATION-SIZE $a != derived $exp"; rc=1; }
exit $rc
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1, prints all 19 offenders, population=19 derived_expected=19. The number 19 is never written down, it falls out of 27 minus 8. The dest() ladder is an independent re-derivation of targetPath() at src/templates/embedded.ts:37-53.

US-002 | The symlink target `templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh` carries the same index mode that main gives the live hook, and is executable on disk. Without this the PreToolUse allowlist is silently disabled on every fresh clone. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
T=$(git ls-files -s -- templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
M=$(git ls-tree main -- .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ -n "$T" ] && [ -n "$M" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN: empty mode"; exit 2; }
[ "$T" = "$M" ] && [ -x templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh ]
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1 (tpl=100644, main-repo=100755). Measured: invoking the repo copy returns rc=0, invoking the template copy returns rc=126 (found, not executable).

US-002 | The hook still executes through its registered path (never exit 126, the POSIX found-but-not-executable code). Species: INVARIANCE PIN (comparand is the POSIX protocol constant plus the resolved mode). Oracle:
env CAM_SESSION=probe .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?
[ "$rc" -ne 126 ] && [ -x .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh ]
Verified GREEN on main 2026-08-11: exit 0 (hook rc=0).

US-002 | Link direction is one-way: `templates/` itself contains no symlinks. Inverting the direction would keep the embed working locally (statSync follows links) while git stores mode 120000 and CI checks out a link-to-a-link. Species: INVARIANCE PIN (literal-free set emptiness). Oracle:
test -z "$(find templates -type l)"
Verified GREEN on main 2026-08-11: exit 0.

US-003 | `bun scripts/generate-repo-overlays.ts --check` exits 0 against the committed tree. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
bun scripts/generate-repo-overlays.ts --check
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1 (module not found).

US-003 | Zero-match, multi-match and drift each produce their own non-zero exit code AND their own positive diagnostic marker. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle:
for fx in zero-match multi-match; do
  out=$(bun scripts/generate-repo-overlays.ts --check --overlay-dir "test/fixtures/overlays/$fx" 2>&1); rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q '^overlay-anchor: ' || { echo "FAIL $fx (rc=$rc)"; exit 1; }
done
out=$(bun scripts/generate-repo-overlays.ts --check --overlay-dir test/fixtures/overlays/drift 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 1 ] && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q '^overlay-drift: '
Swept RED on main 2026-08-11: exit 1. MEASURED TAUTOLOGY, do not use the naive form: `bun scripts/generate-repo-overlays.ts --check --overlay-dir .../drift >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 1` returns 0 TODAY, because a missing module also exits 1. Requiring the positive diagnostic marker plus a distinct exit code per class is what makes it falsifiable (patterns.md: positive evidence the subprocess ran to completion, never absence-of-a-bad-signal).

US-003 | US-003 is a pure refactor: all four overlay destinations stay byte-identical to main. Species: INVARIANCE PIN, comparand derived from `git show main:<dest>`. Oracle:
rc=0
for d in .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md; do
  diff <(git show main:"$d") "$d" >/dev/null || { echo "DRIFT $d"; rc=1; }
done
exit $rc
Verified GREEN on main 2026-08-11: exit 0. Satisfiable through all four stories because US-001 only moves content template-ward for these four paths, so no repo-side file changes.
gotchas: HIGHEST SEVERITY, green gate with lost coverage: `Bun.Glob.scanSync` silently omits symlinks under default options. Measured on bun 1.3.13 against a directory holding 457 symlinks and 1 regular file: default scanSync returned 1 of 458 entries, zero of the 457 symlinks; with `followSymlinks: true` OR `onlyFiles: false` it returned 458/458. `scripts/validate-agents-md.ts:64-65` runs `new Glob('.claude/agents/*.md').scanSync({ cwd, dot: true })` with defaults. After US-002, `subagent-orchestrator.md` and `subagent-planner.md` become symlinks and DROP OUT of the agents-md scan surface (7 targets to 5) WITHOUT the gate turning red. Fix `followSymlinks: true` and keep the derived-target-count pin as a hard acceptance criterion. `scripts/check-file-sizes.ts`, `check-test-sleeps.ts`, `check-test-tmpdir.ts` and `check-debt-markers.ts` also use scanSync but only over `{src,scripts,test}/**`, where no symlinks are planned; that assumption is pinned by the templates-contain-no-symlinks criterion.

ORDERING, and it can break the implementer's own live session: the symlink target is not executable today. `git ls-files -s` reports `.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh` = 100755 and `templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh` = 100644. `.claude/settings.json` registers the hook as a bare command path, so the exec bit is load-bearing; invoking the template copy returns rc=126. Run `git update-index --chmod=+x templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh` BEFORE creating the link, otherwise the implementer loses its own PreToolUse allowlist mid-story. `test/embedded.test.ts` only asserts the MATERIALIZED mode (materializeTemplates chmods 0o755 at write time), so it is blind to this; no existing gate covers the repo's own hook mode.

CROSS-STORY DEPENDENCY, not inferable from the story text: US-003 depends on US-001. US-001 adds roughly 41 lines to `templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md` and rewrites step 3 of `templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md`. Any overlay anchored on pre-US-001 template text goes to zero-match (exit 2) the moment US-001 lands. Author every overlay against the POST-US-001 base.

OVERLAY SEMANTICS, pin it explicitly: every `find` must match exactly once against the PRISTINE base, and all matches must be resolved before any replacement is written. Two pairs rewrite lines containing `unnecessary re-renders` (reviewer line 80 and rubric row 8 at line 120) and two rewrite lines containing `<project typecheck command>` (CLAUDE.md lines 29 and 53). If pairs are applied sequentially against the already-mutated buffer, anchor counts change mid-run and the arity check becomes meaningless.

SIX ANCHORS collide in their short form and need the long form: (a) bare `<project typecheck command>` matches 2 lines, use the 3-line gates block; (b) `NO \`_ref\` channel` matches 2 sub-bullets, include `jscpd also has`; (c) `No hardcoded secrets` matches 2 lines, include the trailing `in code.`; (d) `unnecessary re-renders` matches 2 lines, anchor on the full `| 8 | **perf** |` table row; (e) bare `typecheck` matches 3 lines and bare `\`bun test\`` matches 2, use the prefix through `discovered at review time,`; (f) merge the reviewer's four checklist sections into ONE pair anchored on `### Security` rather than four pairs.

TWO HUNKS REQUIRE TEXT THAT EXISTS ON NEITHER SIDE and must be authored: the implementer's `97c97,107` quality-gate block and the auditor's `91a95,102` section F. A story phrased as "update the template to match the repo" will silently produce a stack-specific base. The generic base text for both is specified in the story body; do not let the implementer improvise it.

NUMBERING HAZARD: propagating the auditor carve-outs (items 21 and 25) into a NUMBERED list renumbers both sides. Merge auditor hunks 3+4+5 into a single overlay pair anchored on `Project-specific sanity`; two separate pairs would strand a base item 21/22 in the middle of the repo's item list.

ZERO HEADROOM on every file this PRD touches. Measured actual/budget: scripts/check-all.ts 491/491, test/check-all.test.ts 478/478, src/commands/setup.ts 1268/1268, src/vendor/_generated.ts 51/51, src/templates/embedded.ts 124/124, scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts 159/159. Each needs a scripts/file-size-budget.json raise plus a dated `_ref` note naming CAM-530, and `git add scripts/file-size-budget.json` BEFORE re-running the gate, because the tracker-ref check reads only the staged diff. index.ts (3366 lines) is NOT budgeted (outside the {src,scripts,test} glob), so INIT_HELP changes are free.

CORRECTION to a common assumption: new `scripts/*.ts` files do NOT need budget entries. `checkSizeCeilings` iterates `Object.entries(budget)` and skips undefined actuals; it never iterates the glob. Proof: scripts/validate-agents-md.ts is 516 lines with no budget entry and the gate is green. Adding entries for the new generator is hygiene, not a gate requirement, so do not write an acceptance criterion asserting the new script has a budget entry.

`test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts` degenerates after US-002 and must be collapsed deliberately, not left alone. Its `describe.each` runs over the repo copy read from disk AND the template copy from `templatesContents`; once the pair is one inode, the two legs differ only by embed staleness, which `embed-vendor` already covers byte-for-byte. Collapse it to a single-source assertion over `templatesContents['agents/subagent-orchestrator.md']` and record that the redundancy now comes from `embed-vendor` plus the symlink-integrity gate. The sibling `test/templates/subagent-reviewer-clean-findings.test.ts` is the OPPOSITE case: subagent-reviewer.md is overlay-generated, so its two legs stay genuinely independent and the test gains value. But no string it asserts may appear in any overlay `find`/`replace`, or an overlay edit could satisfy one leg while breaking the other.

`.claude/commands/direct-fix.md` is tracked in the repo and absent from `templates/`. It is excluded from the symlink population by construction (the oracle iterates the template tree forward) and it must NOT be added to `templates/`: that would make `_generated.ts` 52 lines and trip the 51-line budget.

`test/embedded.test.ts:105` (exact key-set equality between templatesContents and an on-disk walk) is unaffected, but only because of link direction. Both walkers use statSync, which FOLLOWS symlinks; the walk root is `templates/`, and `.claude/` is not reachable from it. Verified: `bun scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts --check` exits 0 with templateFiles=27 and _generated.ts at 51 lines. Note the walkers differ: `walkFiles()` guards with isFile() while the test's own `walk()` does not, so a dangling link inside templates/ throws ENOENT in both but with different messages.

CI runner symlink support is UNVERIFIED and must be a US-002 smoke, not an assumption.

SHELL AUTHORING HAZARDS hit while sweeping, both cost a false result: (a) backticks inside a sed anchor get command-substituted if the oracle is wrapped in `bash -c "..."`; every anchor in this spec contains backticks, so oracles must be delivered as plain multi-line snippets or single-quoted throughout. (b) `grep -F '- **Test quality**:'` fails with "invalid option" because the pattern starts with `-`; it must be `grep -F -e '...'`.
